history.title: Analysis history
history.description: Every query you've sent for AI analysis from Query Intelligence, newest first. Open a row for the full EXPLAIN plan and the AI's response.
history.emptyText: Use "Analyze with AI" on a query in Query Intelligence to start one.
history.stillRunning: Still running — this row updates automatically once the AI responds.

modal.title: Analyze with AI
modal.leadTemplate: Query template — fill in a value for each $N placeholder below to see the query that will actually run.
modal.leadAnonymized: Table and column names below are anonymized before anything is sent to the AI provider.
modal.leadExact: This is the exact query text that will be sent to the AI provider, unmodified.
modal.footnote: Runs EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) against your database, then sends the query and plan to the AI provider configured in Settings. Only literal values are already redacted (pg_stat_statements normalizes those to $1/$2/... before this app ever sees the query) — anonymizing here additionally hides real table/column names.
modal.started: Analysis started. It's running in the background — you'll see a notification on the AI Analysis tab when it's ready, or check there any time.
